title: MAINT: PIV sign response parser comment misleads — length byte IS needed
description: In wp11_piv_sign(), a comment says 'skip the length byte; we don't need it' above the i++ that skips the 7C TLV length. But the subsequent code relies on correct alignment after this skip to find the 0x82 inner tag. The comment is wrong: we need to skip exactly the right number of bytes. Fix: replace comment with: 'Skip the BER-TLV length byte for the 7C container. Single-byte length assumed (see wolfP11-ecb for multi-byte TODO). Per SP 800-73-4 Table 13.' This makes the single-byte assumption explicit rather than hiding it.
